unit_result_entry.title: Freezing predicts a CUE maximum law distinct from short-range Gumbel behavior
unit_result_entry.why_material: Matching the moment form to the circular logarithmic model yields a centered/scaled maximum distribution, a 3/2 logarithmic correction, and a left-tail form that the source contrasts with the 1/2 correction and Gumbel density of short-range variables.

unit_dependency_entry.context_note: The left-column prediction is interleaved with right-column zeta numerical discussion. The explicit prose at lines 257-266 supplies the tail and 3/2-versus-1/2 comparison even where displayed fractions are degraded.

The qualitative law, Bessel-density identification, tail statement, and constants stated unambiguously in prose are accepted; formula-level reuse needs scan verification.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: CUE partition-function moments reduce to a Toeplitz/Selberg law
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The source turns integer moments into Toeplitz determinants, applies their large-N asymptotics, and identifies a Dyson-Morris/Selberg-integral moment form matching a circular logarithmic landscape. This is the mathematical mechanism supporting transfer of the freezing result rather than analogy alone.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: The zeta mean-maximum correction favors logarithmic over short-range correlations
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The first numerical diagnostic compares the distinct centering corrections predicted by logarithmic and short-range models; across the displayed heights the source reports that the 3/2 correction fits the sample means considerably better than 1/2.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: The source's reusable strategic chain is: expose logarithmic covariance, find a structurally matched CUE Fourier field, convert maxima to free energy, identify the partition moments with a circular logarithmic model, and transfer that model's freezing extreme law.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The exact covariance ranges and several moment constants are formula-unsafe in this extraction, and transfer from CUE to zeta remains explicitly conjectural.

related_synthesis_entries.limit: The reported tests are preliminary, converge slowly, omit lower-order arithmetic effects in places, and are not independent validation of the proposed law.
